description: Full coverage replay of saved BMRC MSE heads over held-out ComGenVid test splits.
full_unseen_test: All unseen-generator fakes plus the corresponding real test partition; no train/validation/calibration real IDs are included.
balanced_test: The existing deterministic balanced_indices procedure, applied to the same held-out split.
metrics: AUROC, AP-real (real-positive), AP-fake, with mean and sample SD over three seeds.
important_scope: ComGenVid only. This replay does not supply VideoFeedback or GenVideo BMRC results.
